blocks.note: Link clauses with invariant che when the antecedent is the relative subject or direct object, and choose a governing preposition plus cui for other complements.
Recognize subset and document-reference uses of di cui, the reason pattern per cui, and contexts where a complex preposition requires an agreeing form of il quale.
Replace preposition plus cui with the correctly contracted and gender-number agreeing form of il quale.
Join a second proposition with invariant il che or its prepositional forms del che, al che, col che, and dal che.
Form possessive relatives with article plus cui, making the article agree with the following possessed noun rather than the antecedent.
Translate free and whole-clause relatives with quale, quello che, ciò che, cosa che, and quanto while preserving their differences in kind, capacity, antecedent, and scope.
Choose che after an expressed human antecedent and singular chi when the relative itself supplies the meaning 'the person or people who'.
Complete unrestricted human free relatives with chiunque; the hygiene gate excludes all seven items whose printed key allows competing qualunque-cosa and qualsiasi-cosa answers.
